title: ‘A Dictatorship’: Team Picnic-PostNL Rocked by Allegations of Culture of Fear
content:
Dutch WorldTour team to open independent investigation into accounts of paranoia, distrust, and authoritarianism from dozens of former and current employees.

Read the full article at ‘A Dictatorship’: Team Picnic-PostNL Rocked by Allegations of Culture of Fear on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
